state:
**Goal `html-later` — Stages 3 and 4 are closed. Stage 5 (the proofs gate) is open.** ADR 0266 decides the goal. `crates/nvs-runtime/src/later.rs` holds the slots and both deliveries, and its module doc § *A slotted response* says how the slotted one works and what it costs.

**On disk:** `rule:core-classes/html-later` is `shipped`. The editor answers for `later`. Completion offers a `Core` member's options inside its trailing `{…}` bag (`option_key_at` and `option_keys` in `crates/nvs-lsp/src/completion.rs`), for every member with an options bag, not only `later`. Hover already showed `later`'s card. `completion_offers_the_options_of_later` (`crates/nvs-lsp/tests/completion_edits.rs`) and `hover_on_later_shows_its_card` (`crates/nvs-lsp/tests/navigation.rs`) pin both. The stale perf figures for `Core\Response`, `Core\Response\Stream`, `Core\Session` and `Core\Html` were re-measured into `docs/perf/members.ndjson`.

**`bun nv proofs --gate` now owes exactly two features**, `Core\Html::later` and `Core\Response::slotted`. Each owes everything: `about.md`, 3 examples, 1 attack, 1 bench and a Rust test carrying its `// covers:` marker.

**Known gaps, in `later.rs`'s module doc:** slots run when the frame returns, concurrently with each other but not with the main script. A `later` inside a `Core\Task::all` child is never assembled. A slot whose task is cancelled while it writes ends the stream, and the fills after it are not sent.

items.text: **`Core\Html::later`'s proofs**: `about.md`, three examples with `.out` (`bun nv proofs --bless`), one attack, one bench, and a `// covers: Core\Html::later` line above a Rust test (`crates/nvs-server/src/slotted/tests.rs:74` is the nearest; `crates/nvs-cli/tests/request.rs:101` shows the marker's shape). The card to describe is `LATER_DOC` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/html.rs:403`. `bun nv proofs --id 'Core\Html::later'` lists each path (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`).

**`Core\Response::slotted`'s proofs**: the same six, for the row at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/response.rs:406` (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). Every comment follows `AGENTS.md` § *Text an end user reads*; run `bun nv proofs --comments` over the new files before the wrap.

**The gate is green**: `bun nv proofs --gate` owes nothing; re-measure with `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group G` any group a later edit to `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/html.rs:403` or `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/response.rs:406` makes stale (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`).

backlog: Completion offers every option even when the bag already writes it. Skipping the written ones is a small follow-up in `crates/nvs-lsp/src/completion.rs` (`option_keys`).
The three known gaps above, owned by `crates/nvs-runtime/src/later.rs`'s module doc.
